claim_boundary: This candidate binds one regional SGB soil workbook to the official RIGeo item, bitstream, worksheet schema, record methods and exact sample+lab coordinate joins. It does not represent national Brazil coverage, a known soil horizon or continuous South America coverage.

archive.name: geoquimica_florianopolis_1985.zip
archive.member_inventory_contract: The standalone adapter pins all 14 member names and byte counts and fails on additions, removals or byte-count drift.

qualifier_semantics.ND: not_detected with unknown numeric detection limit

failure_boundaries: Fail if the RIGeo item, bitstream ID, byte count, 14-member inventory, workbook schema or reconciliation counts drift without a reviewed version update.
Fail if NUM_CAMPO + NUM_LAB does not uniquely join every target row to the official SGB soil layer; do not force a coordinate.
Do not convert ND to zero or invent a numeric detection limit.
Do not infer a canonical soil horizon from Nao Identificado or a soil class from Nao Especificado.
Do not infer digestion/preparation from the method name.
Do not represent the 32-sample regional product as national Brazil or South America coverage.
